desc: All Weather cases defend your firearms from damage and the elements. With rugged, industrial-strength construction and a continuous Dri-Loc seal, the case creates a watertight and dust-proof shield that protects your gear even in the most extreme conditions. Heavy-duty, dual-stage lockable latches and a built-in pressure release valve also help the cases withstand the continuous bumping and jarring of airline travel. It utilizes easy glide wheels for transport, pre-perforated pluck foam and a pressure release valve. This model has a black finish and 53.5" x 17" x 7" exterior dimensions.
